# A Generative Slice — Sandbox & Interactive Systems Laboratory

> Official interactive sandbox platform and live demonstration lab for A Generative Slice (agenerativeslice.info), dedicated to showcasing the proprietary Slice Suite: Slice3D, SliceLeads, SliceMail, SliceInbox, SlicePPT, SliceDAM, and SliceClass.

## Core Identity & Operations
- **Platform**: A Generative Slice Systems Laboratory
- **Domain**: https://agenerativeslice.info
- **Parent Company**: A Generative Slice (https://agenerativeslice.com)
- **Founder & Director**: Mohammed Hussain (GitHub: @smdhussain06)
- **Headquarters**: No: 144, Valluvar Kottam High Rd, Nungambakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600034, India
- **Coordinates**: 13.0827° N, 80.2707° E
- **Primary Focus**: Live interactive demonstrations of 3D spatial graphics, agentic AI lead generation, cold email automations, and executive presentation systems.

## The Slice Product Suite — Live Demos
- [Slice3D](https://agenerativeslice.info/slice-3d): Real-time WebGL/Three.js spatial product modeling and 3D web configurations.
- [SliceLeads](https://agenerativeslice.info/slice-leads): Autonomous B2B lead discovery and automated prospecting engine.
- [SliceMail](https://agenerativeslice.info/slice-mail): Cold outreach engine with deliverability optimization and SPF/DKIM/DMARC routing.
- [SliceInbox](https://agenerativeslice.info/slice-inbox): Self-hosted mailbox Chief of Staff AI agent for executive communication triage.
- [SlicePPT](https://agenerativeslice.info/slice-ppt): Instant executive presentation and 16:9 pitch deck builder.
- [SliceDAM](https://agenerativeslice.info/slice-dam): Digital asset vault and automated legal/contract document generator.
- [SliceClass](https://agenerativeslice.info/slice-class): LMS and sub-second video delivery platform for creative studios.
